tools.name: calculate_sales_tax
tools.description: Work out sales tax exactly, in whole minor units. mode "add": amount is the price before tax. mode "extract": amount already includes the tax, and the net price and the tax inside it are returned. rate is a percentage like "8.25". Money is a decimal string. Returns net, tax and gross as decimal stri

tools.name: calculate_tip
tools.description: Work out a tip and split a bill between people, in whole cents. round "none" rounds the tip to the cent; "up-total" rounds the total up to the next whole unit; "up-each" rounds each person's share up to the next whole unit and the total becomes shares times people. Returns tip, total and per_person

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: make_receipt, make_barcode, create_upload · Private data: make_receipt, make_barcode, create_upload · Public sink: calculate_tip, create_upload · Destructive: make_receipt, make_barcode.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: make_receipt, make_barcode, create_upload · Private data: make_receipt, make_barcode, create_upload · Public sink: calculate_tip, create_upload · Destructive: make_receipt, make_barcode

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
